description.value: One Restaurant is the casual, family-friendly dining room within Woodlands Inn & Suites, one of Fort Nelson's primary accommodation hubs along the Alaska Highway. Dinner offerings span house classics like pork schnitzel, butter chicken, fish and chips, and prime rib, plus daily specials — a welcome spread after long riding days on the highway corridor. The adjacent 1 Lounge provides an evening wind-down option with cocktails, mocktails, and light bites like steak sandwiches and rib burgers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms One Restaurant is a real, operating casual dining venue inside Woodlands Inn & Suites at the OSM address (3995 50th Ave South, Fort Nelson, BC V0C 1R0), with the same local phone number (250-774-6669). The site describes a full breakfast buffet and dinner menu but mentions no bike-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.), leaving all amenity fields null. The © 2025 copyright and present-tense descriptions confirm the business is currently open.
concerns: The OSM record lists only One Restaurant, but the website also describes '1 Lounge' as a distinct venue at the same address. If 1 Lounge has or gets its own OSM node, verify there is no duplicate.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, actively operating restaurant at a major hotel in Fort Nelson — a key Alaska Highway waypoint for touring cyclists. No grounds for exclusion.
